prose: Had the great pleasure of hanging out with Mark from My Family Thinks I'm Crazy (Podcast). Check out this big flow!

From the MFTIC show notes: Chance Garton, Host of The InnerVerse podcast joins me to discuss his journey to gain higher understanding, enlightenment and an outlook on life, our reality and our history that is thoroughly inspiring to me. His podcast dives into many of the same subjects and topics that we do, so naturally our conversation achieved flow state, enjoy.

MFTIC music: Soul Experience by Tide Electric; Passing The Ram, Symarshall and Quiet Bites by Sam Barsh; Spellbound by Midnight Dream (Creative Commons Attribution International 4.0, thanks to Soundstripe).
